ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / TA444) ISO/VHD recruiter-lure → explorer-spawned script-host fetch from cloud storage
ucs.description: Hunts the SnatchCrypto / DangerousPassword delivery chain: a messaging/browser client drops an ISO/IMG/VHD container, the user mounts and clicks the LNK inside, and explorer.exe spawns mshta/wscript/cscript/powershell/regsvr32/rundll32 whose command line pulls a second stage from Dropbox, Google Drive, Notion, OneDrive or a compromised WordPress site — Bluenoroff's signature crypto/fintech intrusion path documented by Kaspersky, Mandiant (TA444 / APT38) and Microsoft (Sapphire Sleet).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.iso" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.img" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhd" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vhdx") AND (Filesystem.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","telegram.exe","discord.exe","whatsapp.exe","thunderbird.exe")) by _time Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename _time as drop_time, process_name as drop_source, file_name as container | join type=inner dest user [ | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name=explorer.exe AND Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") AND (Processes.process="*.lnk*" OR Processes.process="*http*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*IEX*" OR Processes.process="*certutil*" OR Processes.process="*scrobj.dll*" OR Processes.process="*\\Volume\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Device\\Cdrom*") by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename _time as exec_time, process_name as child_proc, process as child_cmd ] | where exec_time >= drop_time AND (exec_time - drop_time) <= 3600 | eval delay_sec = exec_time - drop_time | table drop_time exec_time delay_sec dest user container drop_source child_proc child_cmd | sort - exec_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ContainerExts = dynamic([".iso",".img",".vhd",".vhdx"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let DeliveryApps = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","telegram.exe","discord.exe","whatsapp.exe","thunderbird.exe"]);
let ContainerDrops =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in~ ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName has_any (ContainerExts)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (DeliveryApps)
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Container   = FileName,
              ContainerPath = FolderPath,
              DeliveryApp = InitiatingProcessFileName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ (ScriptHosts)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".lnk", "http://", "https://", "DownloadString",
      "Invoke-WebRequest", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression", "certutil", "bitsadmin",
      "scrobj.dll", "\\Volume{", "\\DeviceId\\Cdrom")        // 2nd-stage fetch from mounted container
| join kind=inner ContainerDrops on DeviceId
| where Timestamp between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)              // mount-then-click typically <1h
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, DropTime)
| project DropTime, ExecTime = Timestamp, DelaySec,
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          Container, DeliveryApp,
          ChildProcess = FileName,
          ChildCmd     = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ContainerExts = dynamic([".iso",".img",".vhd",".vhdx"]);
let ScriptHosts = dynamic(["mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe"]);
let DeliveryApps = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","slack.exe","telegram.exe","discord.exe","whatsapp.exe","thunderbird.exe"]);
let ContainerDrops =
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName has_any (ContainerExts)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (DeliveryApps)
    | project DropTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              Container = TargetFileName, DeliveryApp = ActingProcessName;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActingProcessName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where TargetProcessName has_any (ScriptHosts)
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (".lnk", "http://", "https://", "DownloadString",
      "Invoke-WebRequest", "IEX", "Invoke-Expression", "certutil", "bitsadmin",
      "scrobj.dll", "\\Volume{", "\\Device\\Cdrom")
| join kind=inner ContainerDrops on DvcHostname
| where TimeGenerated between (DropTime .. DropTime + 1h)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, DropTime)
| project DropTime, ExecTime = TimeGenerated, DelaySec,
          DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          Container, DeliveryApp,
          ChildProcess = TargetProcessName,
          ChildCmd     = TargetProcessCommandLine
| order by ExecTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) @Image:(*\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*.lnk* OR *http\://* OR *https\://* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *IEX* OR *certutil* OR *scrobj.dll* OR *\\Volume\{* OR *\\Device\\Cdrom*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\.lnk|https?://|DownloadString|Invoke-WebRequest|\\bIEX\\b|certutil|scrobj\\.dll|\\\\Volume\\{|\\\\Device\\\\Cdrom)", field=CommandLine)
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | regex("(?i)\\.(iso|img|vhdx?|vhd)$", field=TargetFileName) | ContextImageFileName=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|outlook|teams|slack|telegram|discord|whatsapp|thunderbird)\.exe$/i}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName,ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: ISO/IMG/VHD containers around a LNK are the documented Bluenoroff lure shape (Kaspersky SnatchCrypto, GReAT 2022-2024 reports; Microsoft Sapphire Sleet write-ups; Mandiant TA444 tracking; CrowdStrike STARDUST CHOLLIMA crypto-theft campaigns). The actor uses the container format specifically to bypass Mark-of-the-Web on the inner LNK, then leans on living-off-the-land script hosts to fetch the seco

ucs.title: [LLM] APT38 / BeagleBoyz post-SWIFT-fraud destructive cleanup sequence (shadow-copy + BCD + event-log + USN-journal wipe)
ucs.description: Hunts the multi-command destructive cleanup APT38 (FireEye/Mandiant), BeagleBoyz (CISA AA20-239A), and NICKEL GLADSTONE have run on victim banking/SWIFT endpoints after fraudulent transactions to destroy forensic artifacts: VSS shadow deletion, Windows Backup catalog deletion, BCD recovery sabotage, event-log clearing, USN journal deletion, and cipher /w free-space wipe — fired within the same short window on the same host.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!=*$ AND (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl*Security*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl*System*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl*Application*" OR Processes.process="*fsutil*usn*deletejournal*" OR Processes.process="*cipher*/w:*" OR Processes.process="*format*/fs:NTFS*/q*/y*") by _time span=15m Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats values(process) as wiper_cmds dc(process) as distinct_cmds min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(parent_process_name) as parents by dest user _time | where distinct_cmds >= 2 | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WiperPatterns = dynamic([
    "vssadmin delete shadows",
    "vssadmin.exe delete shadows",
    "wmic shadowcopy delete",
    "wbadmin delete catalog",
    "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
    "recoveryenabled no",         // 'recoveryenabled No' caught by =~/has
    "wevtutil cl security",
    "wevtutil cl system",
    "wevtutil cl application",
    "fsutil usn deletejournal",
    "cipher /w:",
    "format /fs:ntfs"
  ]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (WiperPatterns)
| extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, 15m)        // 15m = empirical APT38 cleanup-batch window
| summarize WiperCmds   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            DistinctCmds = dcount(ProcessCommandLine),
            FirstSeen   = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen    = max(Timestamp),
            Parents     = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
            ParentCmds  = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 10)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket
| where DistinctCmds >= 2                    // 2+ distinct destructive cmds in 15m = sequence
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WiperPatterns = dynamic([
    "vssadmin delete shadows",
    "vssadmin.exe delete shadows",
    "wmic shadowcopy delete",
    "wbadmin delete catalog",
    "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
    "recoveryenabled no",
    "wevtutil cl security",
    "wevtutil cl system",
    "wevtutil cl application",
    "fsutil usn deletejournal",
    "cipher /w:",
    "format /fs:ntfs"
  ]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| where CommandLine has_any (WiperPatterns)
| extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| summarize WiperCmds   = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            DistinctCmds = dcount(CommandLine),
            FirstSeen   = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen    = max(TimeGenerated),
            Parents     = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, Bucket
| where DistinctCmds >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT38 / BeagleBoyz destructive post-fraud cleanup commands
id: 9c4f1e7a-6b32-4d5e-8b91-2c0a5f3d7e88
status: experimental
description: Detects individual destructive-cleanup commands that comprise the post-SWIFT-fraud wipe pattern attributed to APT38 / BeagleBoyz / NICKEL GLADSTONE (CISA AA20-239A, Mandiant APT38 report). SIEM-side correlation should fire when 2+ distinct commands from this rule hit the same host within 15 minutes.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa20-239a
    - https://content.fireeye.com/apt/rpt-apt38
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
    - attack.impact
    - attack.t1485
    - attack.t1490
    - attack.t1070.001
    - attack.t1070.004
    - attack.g0098
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_vssadmin:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'vssadmin'
            - 'delete'
            - 'shadows'
    selection_wmic_shadow:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'wmic'
            - 'shadowcopy'
            - 'delete'
    selection_wbadmin:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'wbadmin'
            - 'delete'
            - 'catalog'
    selection_bcdedit:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
            - 'recoveryenabled no'
            - 'recoveryenabled No'
    selection_wevtutil:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'wevtutil cl Security'
            - 'wevtutil cl System'
            - 'wevtutil cl Application'
    selection_fsutil:
        CommandLine|contains: 'fsutil usn deletejournal'
    selection_cipher:
        CommandLine|contains: 'cipher /w:'
    condition: 1 of selection_*
fields:
    - User
    - Computer
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
falsepositives:
    - Disaster-recovery drills
    - Sysadmin manually wiping a decommissioned host
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @CommandLine:(*vssadmin*delete*shadows* OR *VSSADMIN*DELETE*SHADOWS* OR *wmic*shadowcopy*delete* OR *wbadmin*delete*catalog* OR *bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures* OR *BOOTSTATUSPOLICY*IGNOREALLFAILURES* OR *recoveryenabled*no* OR *recoveryenabled*No* OR *wevtutil*cl*Security* OR *wevtutil*cl*System* OR *wevtutil*cl*Application* OR *fsutil*usn*deletejournal* OR *cipher*\/w\:*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 
| regex("(?i)(vssadmin\\s+delete\\s+shadows|wmic\\s+shadowcopy\\s+delete|wbadmin\\s+delete\\s+catalog|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled\\s+no|wevtutil\\s+cl\\s+(security|system|application)|fsutil\\s+usn\\s+deletejournal|cipher\\s+/w:)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| bucket(span=15m, function=[count(field=CommandLine, distinct=true, as=distinctCmds), min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName])], field=[aid, ComputerName, UserName])
| distinctCmds >= 2
ucs.rationale: Mandiant's APT38 report and CISA advisory AA20-239A both call out the post-fraud wipe sequence — VSS deletion, BCD sabotage to defeat recovery, event-log clearing, USN-journal removal, and cipher /w over free space — as a Bluenoroff/APT38 hallmark distinguishing them from purely-spying DPRK clusters like Lazarus/HIDDEN COBRA. The 2+ distinct destructive commands within 15 minutes on a single host
